ideas.title: Inline-editable table
ideas.summary: A data table where cells edit in place, Tab and arrows move focus, edits show a pending state then commit, with an undo toast that counts down.

ideas.title: Upload drop zone
ideas.summary: A drag-and-drop uploader with per-file progress rings, thumbnail previews, retry on failure, and a queue summary line. Simulate uploads with realistic timing.

ideas.title: Live stat cards
ideas.summary: A row of stat cards with sparklines, deltas coloured by direction, numbers that tick live in tabular figures, and a hover that reveals the last 7 points.
